messages:
riley: Heads up — PR #18899 is ready but CI is queued. Need to land before Friday blackout (midnight PST). Can someone eyeball and/or grab a rebase window? I'm worried about CI budget — merging now will likely overflow nightly cap. @sam @carol

sam: I can eyeball; what's blocking CI? flake or just queue? can you paste last green commit SHA? :thinking_face:

riley: Queue, not flake. CI backlog bump after big rollout. SHA: abc1234. I'm proposing a short rebase + smoke-only canary to avoid full matrix. Thoughts?

carol: I can take review. smoke-only canary sounds fine. If we can drop the long e2e for the canary it should fit the budget. One flaky test (integration/payment_flow) might fail though — I can patch after rebase. @riley can you rebase onto main and push?

riley: rebased and force-pushed: abc1234 -> def5678. Pushed at 1770130500. please take.

ci-bot: CI queue update — your branch is queued at position 18; estimated start ~7m. Full-matrix would add ~90m to queue. Smoke-only job class available and will start earlier if requested. (link: https://ci.internal/jobs/18899)

sam: @ci-bot can we trigger smoke-only job for this PR? Also, can we get a temporary reorder to prioritize this if carol approves?

ci-bot: Requested: triggered smoke-only for PR 18899. New queue position 6. ETA ~3m.

carol: Taking a quick look now. Left one small nit in the last file. If that's fixed, I'll approve and request merge. :eyes:

riley: Nit fixed and pushed (def5678 -> def5679).

carol: Approved. I'll hold the merge until smoke-only passes and no regression seen. If smoke passes, let's merge into dedicated canary before midnight PST. :+1:

sam: Noted. If smoke passes and we see instability, revert plan is to flip traffic via rollout flag and hold max 1 hour. @product-ops FYI.

riley: Thanks all. ping me for any blockers; I can be on standby during the merge window.
